sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: FCNSW is seeking tenders for drill, blast and crush operations to meet requirements in FY27 and FY28 in the Bathurst Area for this type of gravel treatment.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Opportunity requirements

1.

Complete and submit all the required forms and documents

Contracts can only be awarded to appropriate legal entities that have the financial resources, and capacity, to deliver the goods or complete the services or works under the contract.

Contractors need to provide evidence that they have:

- A fully functioning Safety Management System and Environmental Management System
- Operational ability to carry out the work
- Willing and able to acquire all mandatory equipment with fully trained staff.
- Completed all forms.
